items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: we used to take Erroll Garner around there to play for them... here's Erroll Garner sitting up there playing.

ctx.x: -- in Pittsburgh. And we used to go around there, not to be a purchaser, but we used to like to go hang around -- Danny used to like to go talk to the girls. And we used to take Erroll Garner around there to play for them. If his father knew that --
